channel.title: The Grant Desk - Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.title: VIA Art Fund: Artistic Production Grant (Spring 2027 cycle)
item.description: VIA Art Fund · deadline 05 Nov 2026 · $25,000 to $100,000 per project

item.title: Zoud GameLab 2026: Global Game Jam financial-literacy jam (prize and funding pool up to USD 140,000)
item.description: Zoud (UAE National Financial Wellbeing and Sustainability Initiative) with Global Game Jam · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Shared prize and development-support funding pool of up to USD 140,000 across best overall game, runner-up, third place, financial-literacy impact, regional perspective, compelling gameplay and a Best Game from the UAE award; individual prize amounts are not published. No entry fee.

item.title: 100 Screams: Open Call for Screamers (worldwide, participatory)
item.description: Nguyen Hoang Gia Bao (independent artist) · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · No cash award; a participatory open call. Contributions become part of a 100-hour sound work and spatial installation.

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science and Safety Nodes RFP 2026 (Local Compute; Coordination and Accountability; AI-first Science)
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Grants typically USD 30,000 to 100,000 (smaller awards for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance and Open Governance areas, larger for the rest; bigger amounts possible for the right project), usually paid as one lump sum, with up to 10 percent overhead. Optional office space in San Francisco or Berlin and access to private compute clusters. No application fee.

item.title: Lendhauer: Urban Ecologies - Coexistence and Control (Lendhafen, Klagenfurt 2027)
item.description: Lendhauer (Klagenfurt, Austria) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Artist fee up to EUR 2,500 gross, production costs up to EUR 4,000 gross (depending on project scope), and travel expenses up to EUR 1,000. No application fee.

item.title: MIT Solve: 2027 Global Challenges
item.description: MIT Solve (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Every selected Solver team receives a USD 10,000 grant funded by Solve, plus access to a pool of over USD 1 million in prize funding at selection and additional funding opportunities throughout the program. Sponsor prizes range from USD 100,000 to 200,000, including the AI for Humanity Prize (up to USD 150,000, Patrick J. McGovern Foundation), the Collegium Prize for Innovation (USD 100,000), the Citizens Workforce Innovation Prize (USD 100,000), the Crescent Enterprises AI for Social Innovation Prize (USD 100,000) and the Seeding the Future Prize (USD 150,000). No application fee.

item.title: Bellingcat Contractor: AI Engineer (Open Source Agentic Systems)
item.description: Bellingcat · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Annual contractor fee of USD 80,000 to 93,000 for full-time (40 hours/week), depending on experience and track record; a part-time (20 hours/week) option is also offered, rate not stated.

item.title: GAIN SSA: AI Safety Essentials Fellowship (inaugural cohort)
item.description: GAIN SSA (Global AI Youth Network, Sub-Saharan Africa) · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Micro-grant pool funding top capstone proposals at USD 500 to 1,000 each (capped at USD 1,000), usable for compute access, communication work such as Substack Pro subscriptions for writers, or travel to AI alignment conferences in Sub-Saharan Africa. The fellowship itself is free to attend (no participation fee, no application fee); no stipend is paid during the program.

item.title: Unearthodox Exploration Co-Lab 2027: Edges of Possibility
item.description: Unearthodox · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · CHF 10,000 grant per selected initiative, plus a 10-month incubation programme with tailored coaching, expert support, peer learning, systems mapping and futures-thinking support. No application fee.

item.title: Busan Metropolitan City: Open Call for Land / Ecological Art on Eulsukdo
item.description: Busan Metropolitan City, Urban Parks Division · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · One proposal selected. Artwork support KRW 380,000,000 (approx. EUR 235,000) plus artist fee KRW 20,000,000 (approx. EUR 12,500). No entry fee indicated.

item.title: Fondation Francois Schneider: Talents Contemporains 16th Edition - Water
item.description: Fondation Francois Schneider · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · EUR 15,000 per laureate (merit prize plus acquisition of the work; EUR 8,000 when the work is part of a multiple edition, e.g. photo or video); up to 7 laureates. Sculpture and installation projects can additionally receive up to EUR 50,000 in production assistance. No entry fee stated.

item.title: Internet Society Fellowship Program 2027
item.description: Internet Society · deadline 18 Dec 2026 · Project stipend of up to USD 5,000 (upon submission and approval of the project budget), plus travel support to attend a global or regional Internet event and a dedicated mentor aligned with the project area. No application fee.

item.title: Kulturstiftung des Bundes: General Project Funding, January 2027 round (Allgemeine Projektfoerderung)
item.description: Kulturstiftung des Bundes (German Federal Cultural Foundation) · deadline 31 Jan 2027 · No fixed ceiling, but total project costs must exceed EUR 50,000 to be eligible. The Foundation allocates up to EUR 10 million per year across this line. At least 20 percent of total project costs must be secured from own capital and/or third-party funding. No application fee.

item.title: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab: Visiting Fellowships 2027 (Leuven)
item.description: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,000 per month for three months, covering accommodation and living costs, plus office space, library access and KU Leuven facilities. Five fellowships. No application fee.

item.title: The Open Notebook Early-Career Fellowship 2027 (remote)
item.description: The Open Notebook · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 6,600 stipend over the twelve-month part-time fellowship, plus one-on-one mentoring from an experienced science journalist and published clips at The Open Notebook. No application fee.

item.title: Judson-Morrissey Excellence in New Media Award 2026 (BIPOC students)
item.description: New Media Caucus · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Multiple unrestricted awards of varying amounts up to USD 500 each, funded through donor contributions. Awardees are also featured in an NMC Header/Footer Gallery exhibition and a digitally published interview. Free to apply.

item.title: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen: Call for Films, 73rd Festival (2027)
item.description: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen (International Short Film Festival Oberhausen) · deadline 18 Jan 2027 · International Competition: Grand Prize of the City of Oberhausen EUR 8,000, Principal Prize EUR 4,000, Promotional Prize EUR 1,500, plus a European Film Awards short film nomination. German Competition: EUR 5,000 main prize, EUR 1,500 promotional, EUR 2,500 3sat Emerging Talent Prize (with purchase offer), EUR 1,000 ZONTA Prize for a female filmmaker. NRW Competition: EUR 1,000 and EUR 500 prizes, plus NRW Ministry prizes of EUR 5,000 and EUR 3,000, FIPRESCI Prize, EUR 2,000 Ecumenical Jury Prize, EUR 750 WDR Westart Audience Jury Prize. Children's and Youth: several EUR 1,000-1,500 prizes and an ECFA Short Film Award nomination. Prizes go to the directors. SUBMISSION FEE: first five submissions per submitter are free; EUR 20 handling fee per film from the sixth.

item.title: Bertha Artivism Awards 2027
item.description: Bertha Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to USD 20,000 per one-year activist-art project. Free to apply.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.

item.title: LOEWE FOUNDATION: Craft Prize 2027
item.description: LOEWE FOUNDATION · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 50,000 for the winning entry. No application fee.

item.title: Onassis ONX: ONX Seeds 2026, Soft Circuits for Hard Times (Athens, hybrid)
item.description: Onassis ONX (Onassis Foundation) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 to 5,000 seed funding per project, set by scope; up to four projects selected. item.title: Movies that Matter Festival 2027: Film Submissions
item.description: Movies that Matter · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Cash prizes: EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Documentary award (winner also becomes eligible for consideration for the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature), EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Fiction award, and EUR 1,500 Shorts award; further competitions (Activist Lens, Justice Frame, Dutch Focus, Education Award, Audience Award) publish no amounts. SUBMISSION FEE: EUR 25 until 30 September 2026, EUR 35 late fee 1 October to 1 November 2026; fee waivers only in very exceptional cases.

item.title: Swarovski Foundation: Creatives for Our Future 2026/27 (Global Grant for Emerging Creatives)
item.description: Swarovski Foundation · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · EUR 20,000 grant per selected participant, plus a mentorship and education programme. No application fee.

item.title: ARDC: Amateur Radio and Digital Communications Grants (January 2027 round)
item.description: Amateur Radio Digital Communications (ARDC) · deadline 15 Jan 2027 · No fixed range is stated on the apply page, but ARDC's published 2026 grant portfolio shows awards from USD 1,285 up to USD 258,000 (for example GNU Radio 4 at USD 258,000). No application fee.

item.title: World of WearableArt (WOW) Awards Competition 2027 (Wellington, New Zealand)
item.description: World of WearableArt · deadline 11 Feb 2027 · Over NZD 200,000 in prizes across 25 awards. Per the published 2026 prize schedule: Supreme WOW Award NZD 30,000, runner-up NZD 15,000, section winners NZD 8,000 each. No entry fee.

item.title: Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund (research grants on AI's economic impacts)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 200 million committed overall. Grants primarily in the USD 5-30 million range per project, with a USD 1 million minimum and flexibility upward for well-scoped, high-potential-impact projects. The separate small-grant Research Awards tier (USD 10,000-50,000 plus USD 5,000 in Claude API credits) is currently paused. No application fee.

item.title: Braunschweig Projects 2027/28: Curatorial Fellowship at HBK Braunschweig
item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months (EUR 19,200 total), plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (the fellow pays EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs), a subsidy of up to EUR 4,000 for exhibition activities and a EUR 2,000 travel budget. No application fee (via Submittable).

item.title: Nordic Culture Fund: ENTER 2026 (exploratory cross-border collaboration)
item.description: Nordic Culture Fund · deadline 16 Oct 2026 · Up to DKK 50,000 (roughly EUR 6,700), plus up to DKK 25,000 in additional accessibility support for logistics and access needs, for a maximum total of DKK 75,000. No co-funding required. No application fee.

item.description: Arts Convergences, in partnership with Thanks for Nothing · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 total: Grand Prize EUR 2,000, Jury Prize EUR 1,500, Public Choice Prize EUR 1,500 (online vote). Additional prizes may be awarded. No entry fee.

item.title: Asymmetry Assistant Curator Fellowship 2027-2029 at Nottingham Contemporary
item.description: Asymmetry Art Foundation, with Nottingham Contemporary · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Annual salary of GBP 27,556 for two years, plus pension and National Insurance contributions, annual leave in line with organisational policy plus UK bank holidays, visa and legal fee assistance where required, and a travel and relocation allowance. No application fee.

item.description: Asia-Europe Foundation (ASEF), culture360.ASEF.org · deadline 29 Sep 2026 · SGD 250 fee per commissioned article, podcast or video interview. Up to two proposals per application, of which at most one is selected. No application fee.

item.title: Script Pipeline: First Look Project 2026 (screenplay and TV pilot contest)
item.description: Script Pipeline · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 in total prizes across six winners: USD 2,500 to the winner of each of four screenplay genre categories (Action and Sci-Fi, Comedy, Drama, Horror and Thriller) and USD 2,500 to the winner of each of two TV pilot categories (hour and half-hour). All winners also receive long-term circulation to Script Pipeline's industry network of producers, managers, agents and directors, 1-on-1 development assistance from Script Pipeline execs, additional script reviews and consideration of other material, career guidance and mentorship, and invitations to private Symposium events. Entry fee: USD 60 at the regular deadline, rising to USD 65 (late, 15 October) and USD 70 (extended, 30 October).

item.title: Tokyo Biennale 2027: Social Dive open call
item.description: Tokyo Biennale · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · JPY 100,000 honorarium (incl. tax), round-trip travel expenses up to JPY 300,000 (economy, one person), accommodation in Tokyo, project development support up to JPY 200,000 (incl. tax), plus venue coordination, interpretation and translation support and an invitation letter. No application fee.

item.title: Mozilla Data Collective: Lost in Transcription ASR Challenge
item.description: Mozilla Data Collective (Mozilla Foundation) · deadline 02 Oct 2026 · USD 20,000 total in prizes across three language tracks (per track: USD 4,000 for first place and USD 2,000 for second, plus a bonus award for the lowest average word error rate across all three tracks). No entry fee.

item.title: AI Philosophy Competition: First Edition
item.description: Zachary Goodsell and Elliott Thornley, funded by Forethought Research · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 3,000 first prize, USD 2,000 second, USD 1,000 third, plus a USD 5,000 pool for creative methodology distributed at the judges' discretion (USD 11,000 total). No entry fee.

item.title: Nieman Fellowships at Harvard, Class of 2028
item.description: Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · USD 87,500 stipend paid over the nine-month academic year (2026-27 figure), plus additional allowances for housing, childcare and health insurance. Fellows audit courses across Harvard and participate in Nieman seminars, master classes and workshops. No application fee.

item.title: EMAF 2027: Call for Entries, Film / Installation / Expanded
item.description: European Media Art Festival (EMAF) · deadline 15 Dec 2026 · All films in the International Selection are equal winners of the EMAF Award and receive EUR 400 each. Screening fees: EUR 250 for Features, EUR 80-250 for curated programmes depending on length, EUR 500 for installations and expanded projects; production costs for installations and expanded projects are paid by the festival. Selected artists get free accreditation, three hotel nights (longer if setup requires) and a travel cost contribution. No entry fee.

item.title: Stigler Center: Journalists in Residence Program Spring 2027 (Chicago Booth)
item.description: Stigler Center, University of Chicago Booth School of Business · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · USD 14,000 stipend to cover living expenses over the 12-week program, plus reimbursement of economy-class airfare to and from Chicago, SEVIS and visa application fees, health insurance through UChicago, and housing guidance. The stipend is subject to up to 14 percent tax withholding for international participants, and you need sufficient funds for roughly the first month before the stipend arrives. No application fee.

item.title: IAPS: AI Policy Fellowship Spring 2027 (DC, London or remote)
item.description: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Fellows receive USD 18,000 and Senior Fellows USD 24,000 as a stipend for the three-month full-time program, plus an additional USD 3,000 stipend on the in-person DC or London tracks, healthcare benefits and a USD 500 professional development stipend. Up to 45 fellows. No application fee.

item.title: First Flights Short Film Fund (Autumn 2026 Round)
item.description: First Flights Media Limited, with Kodak and Periscope · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Up to GBP 7,000 / USD 10,000 cash toward production; plus two Kodak awards of 5 x 400ft rolls of 16mm stock with full processing, and one USD 10,000 Periscope post-production package

item.title: Zindi: Bias Bounty Mapping Equity Challenge
item.description: Zindi with Humane Intelligence, Radiant Earth, and the Heising-Simons Foundation · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 10,000 total in prizes: 1st USD 4,500, 2nd USD 2,500, 3rd USD 1,500, Best Bias Discovery USD 1,000, Best Documentation USD 500, plus 10,000 Zindi points. Free to enter.

item.title: UCLA Modern Endangered Archives Program (MEAP): 2026-27 Call for Applications
item.description: UCLA Library, Modern Endangered Archives Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Planning Grants up to USD 20,000 (up to 1 year) for collection evaluation, survey and inventory work before digitization. Project Grants up to USD 70,000 (up to 2 years) for digitization and metadata creation on well-organized collections, or curation of existing digital assets. Regional Grants up to USD 100,000 (up to 2 years) for digital collections drawing on three or more institutions, families or repositories around one theme, hosted by an organization with prior MEAP experience. A separate AV Grants track (up to USD 100,000, for audio, video and film) opens in April 2027. No application fee.

item.title: FUTO Grants for Open-Source Software
item.description: FUTO · deadline Rolling / undated · Microgrants USD 1,000-5,000 for individuals and early-stage projects; larger grants for established projects (over USD 5 million distributed across 20 projects to date, including Signal and Tor)

item.description: Institute for Progress (IFP) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 10,000 honorarium per published project plan; USD 1,000 bounties for successful referrals and published new ideas

item.description: Briarpatch Magazine · deadline 18 Sep 2026 · CAD 150 for profiles, short essays, book reviews and parting shots (under ~1,500 words); CAD 250 for feature stories and photo essays; CAD 350 for research-based articles and investigative reporting (2,000-2,500 words). No pitch fee.

item.description: ARC Prize Foundation · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 2,000,000 total prize pool across three tracks (ARC-AGI-2, ARC-AGI-3 agents, and a paper prize); milestone prizes include USD 25,000 / 10,000 / 2,500

item.title: Anthropic Fellows Program (funded AI research fellowship, January 2027 cohort)
item.description: Anthropic (with Constellation as recruiting partner) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,850 / GBP 2,310 / CAD 4,300 per week for four months of full-time research, plus roughly USD 15,000 per month in compute funding and other research expenses. No application fee.

item.title: apexart Open Calls: Curatorial Proposals for NYC and International Exhibitions
item.description: apexart · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 10,000 per selected exhibition: USD 8,000 for expenses (curator travel, artwork shipping, artist and participant honorariums, equipment, installation) plus an honorarium of up to USD 2,000 for the curator/organizer. For exhibitions outside NYC, apexart matches up to USD 1,000 for venue rental if needed. apexart additionally covers insurance, advertising, publicity, brochure design/printing/mailing, the opening reception and (for NYC) documentation, and handles most logistics. item.description: BlueDot Impact · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to USD 20,000 per grant, paid as a single lump sum after acceptance. No application fee.

item.description: Center on Long-Term Risk (CLR) · deadline Rolling / undated · Grants range from roughly USD 1,300 to over USD 250,000 depending on the project; recent grants span USD 5,000 to 39,000

item.description: Numun Fund · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · Three tiers over two years: Seed USD 10,000-20,000; Grow USD 20,000-50,000; Sustain USD 50,000-100,000

item.description: Federation of American Scientists (Day One Project) · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend for the part-time fellowship (about 5 hours per week), plus a USD 1,000 merit award for the most actionable policy memo and advocacy plan. No application fee.

item.description: Voices With Impact / Art Opening Minds · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · USD 7,500 production grant per filmmaking team

Also included: editorial guidance from the Tech Policy Press team, membership of an international cohort with regular feedback and exchange, and monthly sessions to strengthen the work. Fellows' work is published on the Tech Policy Press website and promoted through the newsletter, podcast and events. No application fee.

item.description: Frameline · deadline 09 Oct 2026 · Grants of up to USD 5,000, with a standard range of USD 1,000 to 5,000; the jury can recommend amounts above or below that range. No application fee.

item.title: 9 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• True Blue Fellowship 2027
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.
  • The Impart & Nalli Fellowships 2027-28
    https://imp-art.org/fellowship-grant/impart-x-nalli-fellowships/
    Impart in collaboration with Nalli Silks · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 5.5 lakhs (INR 550,000) per fellow towards project execution, covering research-related expenses including travel, fieldwork and documentation subject to approval. Two fellowships are awarded. No application fee.
  • Epic MegaGrants 2026 (Cycle 2)
    https://www.unrealengine.com/megagrants
    Epic Games · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · Typical grants range from USD 5,000 to USD 75,000, with some exceptional projects receiving up to USD 150,000. Epic states that recipients continue to own their IP and may publish it however they wish, so this is a grant rather than an investment or equity deal. Grants up to and including USD 25,000 may be paid in a single instalment; larger grants are paid across several instalments tied to continued progress. Funds are for project and team expenses such as development and hiring; hardware purchases or rentals are approved only occasionally, case by case. No application fee.
  • New_ Public Entrepreneur in Residence, Pilot Cohort
    https://newpublic.org/EIR
    New_ Public · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Stipend of USD 22,500, paid in three monthly installments across the residency, each contingent on continued active participation. Plus USD 1,500 toward an AI tool of the resident's choice for coding, prototyping or design. Two residents are selected in the pilot cohort. Also provided: hands-on product and strategy support from senior New_ Public staff and outside experts; access to New_ Public's five years of original research on moderation, governance, community stewardship and platform design, plus direct access to the researchers behind it; and introductions across New_ Public's network of major platforms, startups, university researchers and funders for hiring, fundraising, early user testing and community partnerships. Residents must submit a Form W-9 or W-8BEN to receive the stipend. No application fee.
  • Normsy: Social Media Measurement Methods Incubator RFP
    https://normsy.ai/labs/openrfp
    Normsy (a project of Civic Health Project) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · USD 1,000 awarded to each of the top 5 proposals, plus up to USD 20,000 to fund R&D and/or testing with one selected partner individual or team. Preference for budgets where at least 50 percent goes to research costs (survey respondents, LLM or X API credits). No application fee.
  • This is Gender Regional Curatorial Fellowship 2026
    https://thisisgender.global5050.org/regional-curatorial-fellowship/
    This is Gender (Global 50/50) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · Stipend of up to GBP 3,000 for the seven-month part-time fellowship. No application fee.
  • AI ART AWARD: NEXT ART AI 2026
    https://next-art-ai.com/en/apply/overview
    HOBAN Cultural Foundation · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Total prize pool of KRW 21,000,000 across 20 winners, paid after deduction of applicable taxes and public charges. Grand Prize KRW 5,000,000 (selected regardless of category); in each of the two categories, First Prize KRW 2,000,000, three Second Prizes of KRW 1,000,000 each, and five Honorable Finalist awards of KRW 500,000 each; plus a HOBAN Group President's Award of KRW 1,000,000. Winners also receive plaques and certificates, online and offline exhibition opportunities, and a feature on the official online platform. No entry fee is mentioned.
  • Rest of World: Labor x Tech Reporting Commissions (Year 3)
    https://restofworld.org/rest-of-worlds-labor-x-tech-reporting/
    Rest of World, underwritten by the Ford Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 1,000 per commissioned story of 800 to 1,000 words. No application fee.
  • ILIAD Intensive: Foundational AI Alignment Program (London and Berkeley)
    https://www.iliad.ac/intensive
    ILIAD · deadline Rolling / undated · No tuition. USD 5,000 travel and housing allowance per participant, plus office space at the venue and lunch and dinner five days a week. Cohorts of 15 to 30 participants. Participants arrange and pay for their own travel and accommodation out of the allowance.

item.title: 7 new grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Inato Gallery: Touch Some Grass (open-call poster exhibition)
    https://www.inatogallery.com/open-call
    Inato Gallery · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · No artist fee, stipend or production budget. This is an exhibition opportunity: selected posters are shown in Inato Gallery's Touch Some Grass exhibition. No submission fee is stated in the call.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
  • Physical AI Safety Institute: Research Fellowship (expression of interest)
    https://airtable.com/appYKevtFovAswTXz/pagtcy2ye0OeFf04d/form
    Physical AI Safety Institute (PAISI) · deadline Rolling / undated · Stipend amount is not published. Fellows receive a stipend, access to physical robot platforms, compute for simulation and training, and structured mentorship. PAISI was seeded by a grant from BlueDot Impact.
